title: Quant Voyager — Nexus Weekly Brief
content:
Objective: quick weekly capture for the 'Voyager' compact-quant onboarding funnel. This doc is a running log — informal notes, quick wins, and triage items for the week of 2028-05-04.

Top-line signal: 3-bit grouped quant (group size 64) + selective fp16 attn layer for delta-llama-13b preserves most instruction-following behavior on instruction evals, but fails hard on long-context summarization (>8k tokens). Throughput improved ~3.5x on H100-80GB with microbatch=8, latency SLO at tail increased for 99p by ~12ms due to KV prefetch pressure.

What we tried this week (short bullets):
- Micro experiments: 3b/4b/3-bit-group64 on delta-llama-13b (baseline = fp16). Quick evals: instruction-following subset (instr-400), longform-summary (lf-50), hallucination probes (hall-200).
- KV caching probe: enabled prefetch-on-read and benchmarked runtime mem usage and GC spikes. Observed increased mem churn when head_count>32 (likely due to copy-on-write inside runtime path).
- Eval harness tweaks: added delta-ROUGE (delta from baseline) and consistency-rate (repeat-answer similarity over 3 samplings).
- Onboarding checklist for model-voyager: tokenization sanity, layer-order mapping, attention bias mapping, perf config (quant_profile), rollout flags.

Notable results (numbers are approximate quick-checks, not final):
- 3-bit-group64 vs fp16 on delta-llama-13b: instr-400 accuracy drop ~3.2 percentage points; lf-50 ROUGE-L delta -9.8; hallucination rate +4.1pp.
- Throughput: fp16 = 1200 tok/s, 3-bit = 4200 tok/s (H100, microbatch=8).
- Memory: peak model resident set decreased by ~44% with 3-bit; KV working set increased by ~6% due to prefetch copies.

Interpretation / decisions to make:
- Tradeoff is acceptable for short-form instruction surfaces (chat, code help) but not for long-form summarization or multi-hop chain-of-thought flows. For hosted rollout, we should mark delta-llama-13b/3bit as 'short-context optimized' variant and gate with policy routing.
- Need a fallback strategy: when input length > 6k tokens route to fp16 variant or to dedicated pool. Implement a cheap length-check router in the Console routing rules.

Open experiment ideas (next week baseline):
- Per-channel vs grouped 3-bit: run head-level sensitivity sweep (head 0..n) to find which heads are most fragile under low-bit quant. If fragility concentrates in certain heads we can selectively keep those in fp16.
- Kv-cache zero-copy path: prototyping a non-copy prefetch that pins pages (experimental runtime branch). Measure tail latency at 99.9p.
- Eval expansion: add conversational coherence test (dialog-20chains) and a factual-change detection test (wiki-shift-100).

Action items (owner / eta):
- Priya Nair: run per-channel sensitivity sweep on delta-llama-13b (start dataset: instr-400 + head-probe-50). Due 2028-05-10.
- Diego Alvarez: prototype zero-copy KV prefetch in runtime branch (kv-zero-copy-experiment). Aim for PoC by 2028-05-12.
- Oliver Grant: add router predicate for input-length to Console (rule: length>6k -> fp16 variant). PR + tests by 2028-05-11.
- Maya Chen (me): consolidate eval results into Confluence and notify Solutions Eng to prepare pilot test with two customers (short-context pilot). Due 2028-05-09.

Risks & unknowns: 
- Quantization mismatch with compilation kernels on older GPUs (A100 40GB). Need to validate kernel selection path; fallback currently works but has ~25% perf delta vs H100.
- Regression detection: delta-ROUGE hits false positives for style-based outputs — need to pair with human-review sampler for any failed buckets.

Quick notes from standup chat (raw / unedited):
- "Priya: saw weird loss spikes when quantizing QKV on layer 5, pushing per-channel next"
- "Diego: mem copy is coming from cached-subgraph materialization; investigating refcounts"
- "Oliver: console rule is straightforward, question about canary weight for traffic—do we want 1% or 5%?"

Decisions made this week:
- Canary weight: start conservative at 1% for short-context quant variant. Increase to 5% after 48h no-regression window.
- Eval gating: require delta-ROUGE < -7 and consistency-rate drop < 5pp for promotion to canary. If either fails, keep in private stage.

Misc scratch / commands:
- quick perf run (local): 
  ./bench_runner --model delta-llama-13b-3bit --device h100 --microbatch 8 --input-sz 512 --warmup 30 --steps 500
- kv probe trace: run with RT_TRACE=kv:3 to collect prefetch logs

Notes-to-self: add a small human review queue for lf-50 when we first promote — prefer Solutions Eng curated customer prompts.

Appendix (links + references):
- Confluence playbook (see linked_artifacts).
- PR for model-voyager mapping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-zoo/pull/213
- Runtime issue for KV copy: GH Issue redwood/runtime#1198 (internal)

End of brief. Ping me in #applied-ml if you want a quick walkthrough of the numbers or to grab test inputs.
